content: Navigating from home to the product page is slow. The title should appear immediately.
'll check the product page and its data fetching logic to see what's causing the delay.
I will refactor the product page to use React's `Suspense`. This will allow the title to render immediately while
the inventory data fetches in the background.

parameters.instruction: Refactor ProductPage to use React Suspense so the title renders immediately while the inventory data is fetched in a separate component.

content: I've updated the `ProductPage` to extract the slow `getInventory` logic into
a separate `InventoryDetails` Server Component. By wrapping `InventoryDetails` in a React `<Suspense>` boundary, the Next

.js App Router will now immediately stream the `

Premium Widget

` title to the browser and display a loading state
while it finishes fetching the inventory data in the background.
